explanation: Created EV-FXL-0010 supporting DF-FXL-0007. The CSV shows 40 of 40 tenant totals matching the accounting export, 0 differences.
No penetration test report exists in fx-ledger/sources (or anywhere in the repositories). Nothing was read that shows no cross-tenant access, so EV-FXL-0011 was not created.

The survey does not support DF-FXL-0006. Support asks to keep the ability to refund more than the original (2 of 1,240 refunds, goodwill credits), which runs against the refund cap. Recorded EV-FXL-0012 as accepted evidence that contradicts DF-FXL-0006.

The 2026-10-09 run at 7f3c2e1 has one failing test, 'balance includes an entry dated on the cut-off date' (expected 10, actual 0), which is the core of RQ-FXL-0005. The requirement is not verified, so VR-FXL-0001 was not created.

The 2026-08-01 run is at 1a2b3c4, the prototype where any authenticated user may approve. That predates the rewrite for RQ-FXL-0004 (9d8e7f6, 2026-10-04), and its tests cover the old behaviour, so it does not support the current requirement. EV-FXL-0013 was not created.
